capabilities: Arrange per-type property layouts in a drag-and-drop sidebar with styled sections
Edit properties through rich value types (numbers, sliders, dates, colors, images, lists)
Compute derived values from influence chains, formulas, and cross-note aggregates
Roll dice in the sidebar, inline in notes, and via saved macros with a roll history
List and edit every note of a type in a sortable, filterable table view
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a BRAT beta channel runs ahead of the store release; full accessibility details live in a separate ACCESSIBILITY.md.
problem: Obsidian's properties panel only lists plain key-value fields, with no per-note layouts, rich editors, computed values, or domain-specific views like character sheets.

relations.evidence: so themes and the Style Settings plugin can restyle Extended Properties without !important
install the BRAT plugin, then Add beta plugin with this repository's URL

summary: Configurable sidebar that renders note frontmatter as interactive sections with rich value types, dice rolls, and an optional D&D 5e sheet module.
